unsupported_with_evidence.request_user_dialog: CLI 2.1.312 initialize schema: supportedDialogKinds is 'First-attached-client-wins on multi-client sessions; later initializes do not change it'; requestUserDialog is sent only for declared kinds, else the flow degrades to its no-dialog behavior. On cloud workers the host process attaches first, so an API client cannot cause a dialog for itself. No pending_user_dialog_requests observed (0).
unsupported_with_evidence.hook_callback: CLI 2.1.312: hooks_applied is 'false when a repeated initialize's hooks were ignored (a client joining a remote session another client configured)'; only the process owning stdin may replace hooks. Repeated live: initialize with PreToolUse hookCallbackIds returned hooks_applied:false.
unsupported_with_evidence.chrome_forced_ask: CLI: askForTools forces ask only for Claude in Chrome safe permissionless tools (e.g. tabs_context_mcp). Current web bundle (shared-p-m-0 chunk: QS='claude-in-chrome'; session chunk cicStubForcePin -> set_mcp_permission_mode_override{serverName:QS, mode:'default'}) sends no askForTools in any loaded script. The owned cloud worker exposed no claude-in-chrome server (13 servers, none named so). Connecting one needs the user's browser-extension relay, a connector action outside authorization; not attempted.
